title: Complete the autonomous post-freeze loop (finish #119 G-D)
outcome: shiki loop run self-drives a low/medium-risk task from ready to auto-merged done with zero manual pre-clearing: implement -> loop-observed TDD evidence -> independent code-review -> commit/push -> PR -> checks+CCA pass -> MergeGate green -> auto-merge -> done -> goal complete.
completion_conditions: A stubbed-runner + stubbed-reviewer contract test drives the full dispatch->tdd-evidence->code-review->commit/push->create_pr->merge->done path including the failure->repair branch.
A live shiki loop run on a low-risk claude-code task self-drives to auto-merge + goal complete with no manual pre-clearing.
validate_shiki.py + the unit/contract suite stay green.
non_goals: Changing CCA verdict semantics, the MergeGate required-check set, branch-protection contexts, or the Guardian policy.

grill_with_docs.source: Requirements Definition session 2026-06-17 (/shiki Goal mode) for #140; live loop verification + CI-08 Workflow sweep + ADR 0011.
decisions: Q1: autonomous quality-gate evidence = deterministic observable facts + an independent verifier, never runner self-attestation (ADR 0011).
Q2: read-only claude -p code-review verifier, structured verdict, fail-closed, blocking->repair loop.
Q3: TDD evidence = loop-observed green; red-first not gated.
Q4: create_pr syncs the full ledger_evidence set to the branch.
Q5: loop-task registration auto-includes path:.shiki/** + validator hint.

spec_freeze.source: Operator Spec Freeze approval for PRD 0002 / issue #140 (this session, 2026-06-17). Scope inventory (SF-02): no new external scopes/permissions (existing gh + claude subscription; reviewer is read-only).

tasks.title: Branch plumbing: commit+push implementation + full ledger-evidence sync
tasks.scope: Land the implementer's work and complete evidence on the task branch before create_pr (gaps #1/#2). Add a loop-owned commit+push-implementation step after a green dispatch (commit the worktree source changes; git push -u origin <expected_branch>). Rewrite _sync_state_to_branch (scripts/shiki_loop.py) to copy EVERY file referenced by the reloaded task.ledger_evidence (each .shiki/ledger/<id>.json plus every .shiki-relative path in that ledger's evidence list, e.g. .shiki/runner/EXEC-*, .shiki/reports/R-*) into the worktree, then add/commit/push; reorder so the branch is pushable before create_github_pr_for_task (scripts/shiki_github.py:293). Deterministic, fail-closed, loop-owned.
acceptance_checks: create_pr commits+pushes the runner's worktree implementation; the PR opens with the implementation diff present.
_sync_state_to_branch copies the full task.ledger_evidence set plus referenced .shiki evidence files to the branch (MergeGate metadata passes).
tests/test_loop_engine.py covers the new effectors; python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py and the suite are green.

tasks.title: Loop-observed TDD evidence + per-task test command
tasks.scope: Insert a loop-owned step at the top of the create_pr action (before create_github_pr_for_task) that runs the task's tests in the worktree and records a type:check ledger (EXEC record + a ledger naming skill tdd, evidence=EXEC ref) — loop-observed green (ADR 0011, Q3). Add a structured per-task test_command field (Assumption Log: acceptance_checks is free-form prose+commands and unsafe to exec; default to 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests'). Thread a '## TDD evidence (loop-observed)' line into github_pr_body. Fail-closed: a red pre-PR test run does NOT open the PR (stop_blocked, since dispatch_repair is PR-gated).
acceptance_checks: The loop runs the task's tests in the worktree and records a type:check ledger naming tdd with an EXEC evidence ref; a red run blocks (no PR) fail-closed.
A structured per-task test_command field exists with a safe unittest-discover default; acceptance_checks is never exec'd directly.
github_pr_body carries the loop-observed TDD section; MergeGate required_skill=tdd + CCA V-01 pass; suite green.

tasks.title: Independent code-review verifier (read-only claude -p)
tasks.scope: Add an independent read-only code-review verifier run before create_pr (ADR 0011, Q1/Q2): a reviewer dispatch (claude -p, --allowedTools restricted to read tools, --json-schema structured findings verdict) in a separate context, as a reviewer runtime distinct from the bypassPermissions implementer adapter (scripts/shiki_runtime_adapters.py). The loop parses the verdict deterministically (parse/dispatch failure = fail-closed -> block), records a code-review ledger, and writes the '## Pre-PR code review' PR-body section (scripts/shiki_github.py github_pr_body) from it. Blocking findings feed the existing repair loop (verdict -> repair packet -> fix -> re-review), bounded by the 3-attempt limit.
acceptance_checks: A read-only claude -p reviewer is dispatched before create_pr and emits a structured verdict; parse/dispatch failure is fail-closed (blocks, never passes).
The loop records a code-review ledger + writes the ## Pre-PR code review PR-body section; CCA PR-12 + MergeGate required_skill=code-review pass.
Blocking findings drive the existing repair loop (3-limit); contract test covers clean + blocking-findings paths; suite green.

tasks.title: Loop task-lock guard: auto-include .shiki/** + validator hint
tasks.scope: Loop-executed tasks must lock path:.shiki/** (the loop syncs .shiki evidence to the branch) (gap #5, Q5). Auto-include path:.shiki/** in locks at loop-task registration (scripts/shiki_tasks.py); make validate_shiki.py / shiki doctor warn when a loop-executed (claude-code/codex) task lacks it.
non_goals: No change to lock semantics for non-loop tasks.
acceptance_checks: A loop-executed task registered without path:.shiki/** gets it auto-included (or validate_shiki/doctor warns).
validate_shiki + the suite stay green; a regression test covers the guard.

tasks.title: End-to-end verification: stubbed contract test + live loop self-drive
tasks.scope: Prove the loop self-drives. Add a stubbed-runner + stubbed-reviewer contract test (pattern: scripts/test_shiki_runner_claude.sh / scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh) driving dispatch -> tdd-evidence -> code-review -> commit/push -> create_pr -> checks -> merge -> done, including the failure -> repair branch. Then the acceptance gate: a live shiki loop run on a low-risk claude-code task self-drives to auto-merge + goal complete with no manual pre-clearing (recorded as evidence).
non_goals: No new product behavior beyond verification.
acceptance_checks: The stubbed contract test exercises the full dispatch->PR->merge->repair path and is green in CI.
A live shiki loop run on a low-risk task reaches auto-merge + goal complete with zero manual pre-clearing, recorded as durable evidence.
